spans.s:
ṛddhi
(‘plenitude’)
------------------------------------------
Anything that helps one to increase his power or greatness or influence over others is a ऋद्धि.
Different works list the ṛddhis in different ways. They may be seven or eight in number.
The seven ṛddhis are: बुद्धि (intellect), तपस् (austerity), vikriyā (change), auṣadhi (medicines and drugs), रस (essence, juice), बल (strength) and akṣīṇa (not declining). If kṣiti (land) is added, it becomes eight.
Each one of these is further sub-divided into eight aspects. The ṛddhis then come to a very large number. Many of these are extraordinary psychic powers, often included under the term siddhi also.
Ṛddhi and Siddhi are sometimes described as the two wives of गणपति. (See GAṆAPATI also.)
